command.name: mobile-workbench-builder
command.command: codex exec --full-auto 'Implement only Phase A of docs/reverse-engineering/pocket-ide-mobile-agent-workbench.md. Build an independently authored, side-effect-free mobile-workbench/v1 domain module plus deterministic tests. Do not add a native Android client, network calls, shell execution, Git mutation, package installation, deployment, or donor source. Preserve existing behavior. Run the narrowest focused tests before returning.'

repairCommand.name: mobile-workbench-repair
repairCommand.command: codex exec --full-auto 'Read $SHIPPING_CONTEXT_FILE and $SHIPPING_FAILURE_FILE plus docs/reverse-engineering/pocket-ide-mobile-agent-workbench.md. Repair only the failing Phase A Mobile Agent Workbench gate. Do not broaden scope, use network, push, merge, deploy, or add native/device side effects. Run the narrowest relevant tests.'

goldenPath.description: A mobile device capability profile is validated and receives a stable canonical digest.
Local execution preflight fails closed for unsupported architecture or insufficient declared memory/storage/runtime capability.
Remote execution requires a known capable Agent Work OS machine identity and preserves exact workspace/source identity.
Process loss or restart reconciles in-flight mobile work to interrupted and never fabricates completion.
Preview readiness requires positive health evidence bound to the exact run/workspace/source identity.
Local-to-remote handoff rejects workspace/source digest mismatch and never claims live-process migration.
Secret-like literal values are refused from persisted run and receipt payloads.
Completion requires independent verifier evidence; a builder completion claim alone is not terminal truth.
